Originally a ''[[starcraft:StarCraft|Brood War]]'' clan, the team switched to [[starcraft2:StarCraft|StarCraft II]] during the ''SC2 Beta'' in 2010, and became one of the most successful foreign teams. On May 30th, 2024, Team Liquid initially went into a partnership with [[Team Gullit]] for the [[Esports_World_Cup/2024|Esports World Cup]].
